## TickLib.tickToRate() function

Converts a Midnight tick into a WAD fixed rate.

This is an SDK-only rate conversion convenience.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function tickToRate(tick: BigIntish): bigint;
```

## Parameters

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

bigint

WAD fixed rate rounded up.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when `tick` is negative.

`TickOutOfRangeError` when `tick` exceeds `MAX_TICK`<!-- -->.

`DivisionByZeroError` when the tick price is zero.

## Example


```ts
import { TickLib } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const rate = TickLib.tickToRate(6744n);
console.log(rate);
```
